items.docs: Creates a new case and performs synchronous screening in a single request. Returns all matched screening results within the response. Optionally enables ongoing screening by setting the caseScreeningState to WATCHLIST with ONGOING monitoring.

params.name: resultId
params.description: The unique identifier of the screening result to resolve.

items.docs: Resolves a specific screening result match by assigning a resolution status such as True Positive, False Positive, or Unresolved. The valid resolution options depend on the group's resolution toolkit configuration.

params.name: since
params.description: Filter updates since this date-time in ISO 8601 format.

items.docs: Retrieves all ongoing screening updates for cases that have been flagged for continuous monitoring. Returns cases where new matches have been found or existing matches have changed since the last screening cycle.
Retrieves all groups available in the account. Groups are used to organize cases and configure screening parameters such as provider types, match thresholds, and resolution toolkits.

params.name: groupId
params.description: The unique identifier of the group.

items.docs: Retrieves the details and configuration of a specific group including its screening settings and resolution toolkit.

params.name: groupId
params.description: The unique identifier of the group.

items.docs: Retrieves the resolution toolkit configuration for a specific group. The toolkit defines the valid resolution statuses, risk levels, and reasons that can be applied to screening results for cases belonging to the group.

params.name: profileId
params.description: The unique identifier of the World-Check profile.

items.docs: Retrieves the full reference profile details for a matched entity from the World-Check database, including biographical information, associated countries, linked entities, and source documents.
